Samir: Quick pass to CS/support/eng for BlueOak — short context: enterprise deal signed yesterday, dedicated capacity in us-west2, want SAML SSO + VPC peering, and a private certificate workflow. Go-live target 2024-08-15. Primary customer contacts: Priya (IT) and Jorge (product). They expect ~10k MAU, median session ~600 tokens, some long documents up to 6k tokens. Renewal in 11 months (high priority to lock success metrics). Main risks: SSO mapping pain, potential latency spikes for long responses, and a request for a custom-fine-tune down the road. Asking: who owns what and next steps for provisioning + support/eng triage?

Rachel: Thanks Samir :thumbsup: I can be CS owner. Immediate plan: 1) kickoff call w/ Priya/Jorge this week 2) onboarding runbook + provisioning checklist 3) enablement session for BlueOak PMs. Ben — can you own infra/model triage? Linda — support/esc matrix?

Ben: I can own infra/model work. Need clarification: dedicated or private deploy? Also need representative request traces (seq length distribution) and model preference (open model or customer-supplied). For quantization/kernel recs I need sample payloads and expected concurrency.

Samir: Dedicated GPU pool with VPC peering (no on-prem). Customer prefers an open foundation model with custom fine-tune later. I'll DM sample request logs and test prompts.

Linda: I'll own support escalation and runbook ops. Recommend opening a support ticket for SSO cert exchange + test plan now. Also want a documented on-call escalation path to Eng for perf incidents.

Samir: Sharing SAML metadata snippet here for convenience — please store securely: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://saml.blueoak.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">...
</EntityDescriptor>
``` Priya can provide full metadata and cert.

Priya: Hi all — confirmed timeline. We need KMS integration for keys and encrypted log retention for 7 years (compliance). Also prefer weekly sync for first 4 weeks after go-live.

Jorge: Product note — we will do many multi-turn long outputs (2–3 passages, ~3k tokens). Token cost is a concern; want cost/perf tradeoffs documented. Also will likely ask for a small fine-tune for domain behavior after first month.

Ben: Noted. For perf: what's expected steady-state QPS and burst? That determines batch sizing and latency SLOs.

Samir: Estimate steady 0.5 QPS, bursts up to 10 concurrent requests during peak. Latency target: median < 250ms for short prompts (<256 tokens); 99p for large responses can be higher but want to monitor.

Linda: I'll create the support ticket for SSO + provisioning, add monitoring playbook (alerts for 95/99 latency and error %), and link PagerDuty escalation to Eng (Ben).

OnboardBot: Created onboarding runbook BO-1121 and task list: provision-dedicated, VPC-peering, SAML-exchange, KMS-setup, enablement-sessions. Owner tags added.

Rachel: Action items summary: 1) Rachel — schedule kickoff + weekly syncs 2) Ben — infra + perf recommendations, request sample traces by EOD Thu 3) Linda — open support ticket and escalation matrix by tomorrow 4) Samir — send full SAML metadata + sample payloads 5) Priya/Jorge — confirm access and timelines. Rachel will post the runbook link here once BO-1121 is finalized. Anything missing?

Jorge: Add a cost watch: please include a projected token-cost estimate for expected traffic in the runbook.

Samir: Good call. I'll work with finance to get a rough estimate and upload. Will follow up with Priya to confirm cert exchange window.

Rachel: Great — I'll take the kickoff invite after Ben confirms availability. Thanks everyone — will update this thread with the runbook link and meeting invite. :calendar:
